results.name: the design is made at once from the brief, and looked at as rendered pixels before it is shown
1  “Make this cloud themed.”: clouds drawn as editable shapes, the sky graded, the words exactly kept
2  “Make it more interesting.”: measured first — what holds it back said, then changed (no question needed)
3  the faces kept role by role and the logo kept, the composition and the ground redesigned
4  an identity generated from the words: new faces and colours, the same words and arrangement, the reason said
5  only the headline, a little smaller (a nudge, under 10%)
a comment on the selected headline (“make this warmer”) changes the headline alone, and is kept as done
7  controls made for this design (named for its own forms and its headline) genuinely change it and read back
undo takes a control’s change back
6a “Try something completely different” makes a second design on its own artboard, in another direction (its own colours and faces), the first unchanged
6b the combination is a new artboard: the first’s typography on the second’s composition, both sources unchanged, nothing failing
“critique it”: the design rendered and measured as pixels, then the objects checked — said as such
12 five versions from the brief, each on its own artboard, structurally different (no pair the same structure; measured)
11 reopened: every artboard, the comment, each artboard’s own look and the whole conversation are as they were
and the versions to go back to
8  with no search provider configured here, the conversation says so plainly — no results invented, other ways offered
8b found references are shown as cards, each linked to its source (opened safely), each with “Use as a reference”
8c choosing one reads it through the guarded reader — here it cannot be reached, and that is said, not faked
9  a website is made (no model): its sections composed for the brief, with a working contact form
rendered in its sealed frame, with navigation; at phone width nothing runs off the side
10 an original logo: valid SVG, editable vector objects, concepts and variants to choose from
no page errors
no model was needed or used: every model route refused, nothing waited on it
